source: Secrets' status record, maintained in the repository and checked against main

items.label: Workload routes: put, get, exists, list, delete
items.detail: Behind Kubernetes TokenReview and a local grant file; one action per route.

items.label: User routes: list, detail, revoke, delete
items.detail: Behind Identity; metadata only, and only for secrets the caller owns.

items.label: Prepared batches
items.detail: Prepare, commit and abort; sealed like a value, applied in one transaction, expiring after 600 seconds.

items.label: Stable refusal codes
items.detail: Every refusal is {"error", "code"} and echoes no part of the request.

items.label: Envelope encryption with associated data
items.detail: AES-256-GCM per version, a versioned keyring mounted read-only, and key rotation with secrets rewrap.

items.label: Audit events for every change
items.detail: Written in the same transaction; no API reads them, and some actors are caller-chosen.

items.label: ESS specification and conformance suite
items.detail: secrets.custody retrofitted from the code; 111 scenarios run against the real router and PostgreSQL on every check.

items.label: Rewrap of every stored version
items.detail: secrets rewrap re-encrypts every stored version under another key, current or older.

items.label: Verified principal as every audit actor
Named, scoped secrets over several backends
items.detail: The secrets.storage domain: OS keychain, read-only 1Password and this service behind one interface.

items.label: Local CLI that never prints a secret
